content.short: CryptoPay is a Web3 wallet tool that enables crypto payments from supported networks and offers built-in WooCommerce support plus API integrations.
content.description: CryptoPay is a Web3 wallet tool that enables you to receive crypto payments across multiple networks, including Bitcoin, Solana, Tron, Ethereum and other EVM-compatible chains such as Polygon, Avalanche and BNB Chain, along with the tokens issued on those networks. It offers built-in WooCommerce support and can be integrated with additional plugins through its API, making it easy to expand checkout functionality on your site.
content.meta: CryptoPay enables crypto payments from networks like Bitcoin, Solana, Tron, EVM-based chains. Discover CryptoPay and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
